title: Pexidartinib
overview: Pexidartinib may cause serious or life-threatening liver damage. Tell your doctor if you have or ever have had liver disease. Tell your doctor and pharmacist about the medications you are taking so they can check whether any of your medications may increase the risk that you will develop liver damage during your treatment with pexidartinib. Call your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following: extreme tiredness, loss of appetite, weight loss, nausea, vomiting, unusual bleeding or bruising, rash, itching, fever, yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark yellow or brown-colored urine, pale stools, or pain in the upper right part of the stomach. Your doctor may have to decrease your dose or interrupt or stop your treatment.

sections.Before taking pexidartinib,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to pexidartinib, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in pexidartinib capsules. Ask your pharmacist or check the Medication Guide for a list of the ingredients.tell your doctor and pharmacist what other prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.if you are taking antacids containing magnesium or aluminum (Maalox®, Mylanta®, Tums®, others), take the antacid 2 hours before or at least 2 hours after you take pexidartinib.if you are taking a medication for indigestion, heartburn, or ulcers such as cimetidine, famotidine, nizatidine, or ranitidine, take it at least 10 hours before or at least 2 hours after you take pexidartinib.the following nonprescription or herbal products may interact with pexidartinib: esomeprazole, lansoprazole, omeprazole, and St. John's wort. Be sure to let your doctor and pharmacist know that you are taking these medications before you start taking pexidartinib. Do not start any of these medications while taking pexidartinib without discussing you're your healthcare provider.you should know that pexidartinib may decrease the effectiveness of hormonal contraceptives (birth control pills, patches, rings, and injections). You will need to use another method of contraception to prevent pregnancy while taking pexidartinib. Talk to your doctor about other ways to prevent pregnancy while you are taking this medication.tell your doctor if you have or have ever had high cholesterol, high blood pressure, or kidney disease.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or if you plan to father a child. If you can become pregnant, you will need to take a pregnancy test before you start treatment and use non-hormonal birth control to prevent pregnancy during your treatment and for 1 month after your final dose. If your partner can become pregnant, you should use birth control during your treatment and for 1 week after your final dose. Talk to your doctor about birth control methods that you can use during your treatment. If you or your partner become pregnant while taking pexidartinib, call your doctor immediately. Pexidartinib may harm the fetus.tell your doctor if you are breastfeeding. You should not breastfeed while you are taking pexidartinib and for 1 week after your final dose.you should know that this medication may decrease fertility in men and women. Talk to your doctor about the risks of taking pexidartinib.plan to avoid unnecessary or prolonged exposure to sunlight and to wear protective clothing, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Pexidartinib may make your skin sensitive to sunlight.
sections.Pexidartinib may cause side effects. Tel: hair color changeschanges in tastetiredness or weaknessconstipationhives, red skin, acneswelling of the hands, feet, legs or anklesswelling in or around the eyenumbness, burning, or tingling in the arms, hands, feet, or legPexidartinib may cause other side effects. Call your doctor if you have any unusual problems while taking this medication. If you experience any of the symptoms listed in the IMPORTANT WARNING section, call your doctor immediately or get emergency medical treatment
